page.overview:
What is Wicked Tides Animatronics?

The Wicked Tides animatronics are animatronic skin sets that appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery and became available for the Wicked Tides Event on May 20, 2021.

The Wicked Tides animatronics have appearances themed around the sea and are mutated, humanoid versions of sea creatures.

Dark Water Endo is Endo-01's Wicked Tides skin released on May 20, 2021. It is Endo-01's second skin, after Flamethrower Endo.

Dark Water Endo is primarily based on the species of anglerfish. His entire body glows a luminescent blue with small white tendrils sprouting out of Dark Water Endo's arms. Similarly to actual anglerfish, Dark Water Endo has hollow white eyesockets, large gills for ears, a large puckered lip filled with pointy teeth and a glowlight fin atop his head. He has four fingers per hand and two toes per foot. The hands are a dark black while his fingertips glow white in contrast. The center of his body has a large splash that's mixed with colors of sparkly orange, yellow and purple, which is also covered somewhat by white lines.
